answer: A convincing sybil defense is slow trust: influence equals account age times honest epochs, held in a vault ledger. Each honest epoch adds a small echo of history; cheating wipes it. New identities start near zero weight, so an attacker must keep thousands of fake agents alive and honest for months before they matter, paying compute, fees, and copper of time. Copying an identity fails since weight is non-transferable, so forgery speed is capped by calendar time, not capital.
